d:
Deep in the Mexican jungle, award-winning National Geographic photojournalist Anand Varma is on assignment to photograph the continent’s rarest creatures: carnivorous bats. For centuries their lives have remained a mystery, but Varma and a world-renowned bat biologist are teaming up to uncover their secrets with never-before-seen images
Giant Carnivorous Bats | SPECIAL
